title: NeuriCo reconstructed world model (v3 — findings as spine, everything is a decision)

experiments.description: Domain-general INVESTIGATIONS — the structured activities the run performed to gather evidence for a hypothesis/question. NOT pipeline agent stages: one node per distinct test/analysis/derivation actually carried out (a benchmark eval, an activation-patching analysis, a formal proof, a thematic coding). The pipeline stage that executed it is provenance (`ranBy`), not the identity. Kept under the `experiments` key and `E` id prefix for back-compat.

mode.description: How this investigation gathered evidence — the domain discriminator. Optional for back-compat; required by the v3 prompts for new builds.

name.description: What the investigation IS, in the run's own terms (e.g. 'GSM8K grounding eval', 'head 9.6 activation patching', 'O(n log n) tightness proof'). The node's identity for display.

design.description: Domain-neutral: what was varied / examined / derived, and at what scope.

ranBy.description: Provenance: which NeuriCo pipeline stage executed it (e.g. experiment_runner). Optional — NOT the identity.

agent.description: DEPRECATED legacy pipeline-stage label (resource_finder/experiment_runner/paper_writer). Superseded by `ranBy`; retained so pre-v3 models still validate.

hypothesis.description: The H-id(s) this investigation addresses (comma-separated for several), or '' for none.

findings.description: The SPINE of the world model. Each finding is the unit of insight the run produced (or failed to produce) — and is itself gradeable: a reviewer may judge that a finding is meaningless and should not have been a finding at all. The decisions that produced a finding hang off it via decision.finding, ordered by layer (hypothesis -> method -> experiment_design -> interpretation).

insight.description: The implication / so-what — the most ultimate unit above the raw result. Optional; null when the finding carries no claim beyond the number.

decisions.description: Everything is a decision: a hypothesis chosen, a method picked, an experiment designed, a result interpreted, a finding accepted as a finding. Every decision belongs to exactly one finding (decision.finding = an F-id) or to the project as a whole (decision.finding = 'global'), and sits in one of four layers. importance ranks decisions WITHIN a finding so a reviewer can skip the routine tail.

finding.description: The finding this fork belongs to (an F-id present in findings[]), or the literal 'global' for a project-wide fork tied to no single finding.

layer.description: Where in a finding's lifecycle the fork sits. hypothesis = what to test; method = the way (scrutinized when a result looks wrong); experiment_design = how the experiment was scoped/run; interpretation = what the result means, incl. whether it counts as a finding.

phase.description: Legacy pipeline phase. Optional in v3 — `layer` is the primary axis. Kept for back-compat and timeline ordering.

importance.description: OPTIONAL in the world model — assigned by the Pass-2 PI reviewer (paper-reading) and carried in the review overlay (decision-review.json), not set by the extractor.

sequence.description: Within-finding causal order index assigned by the graph/sequence review pass; lower = earlier in the reasoning chain that built the finding. Optional (set post-extraction).

assessments.description: DORMANT in v3. Retained for back-compat and possible revival; not produced as a top-level node by the v3 pipeline. The only load-bearing signal it carried — engage_user — now lives on every decision as shouldEngage.

incidents.description: DORMANT in v3. Failures are no longer a top-level node type; an interpretation-layer decision links to them via relatedErrors when a fault is load-bearing. Retained so the Errors view can be revived without a schema break.

frontPageDecisions.description: About 3 (up to 5) D-ids a reviewer can soundly judge from the abstract alone — picked for a quick, broad read on run quality by a separate abstract-only selection call. Optional; the UI falls back to top decisions by importance when absent.
